env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=0
# Pin the default experiment set: the harness passes ambient GOEXPERIMENT
# through, so an inherited nojsonv2 would fail the default run below.
env GOEXPERIMENT=

cd variants

# With the default arena policy the helper appends logosarena to the
# GOEXPERIMENT it receives. The selector must resolve candidates through
# the same policy, so a candidate the helper cannot select is skipped
# instead of matching.
logos run .
stdout '^variant arena$'

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/a_v1.go
exists out/a_v2.go
grep 'goexperiment.logosarena' out/a_v1.go
grep 'goexperiment.loopvar' out/a_v1.go
grep 'goexperiment.logosarena' out/a_v2.go
grep 'goexperiment.loopvar' out/a_v2.go

# Plain go leaves the arena experiment off, so it selects the other
# variant. Both selections prove both files were staged with working
# constraints.
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
stdout '^variant loopvar-or-noarena$'
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosarena
go build ./...
go run .
stdout '^variant arena$'

-- variants/go.mod --
module example.com/arenavariant

go 1.27

-- variants/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println(which()) }

-- variants/a_v1.lgo --
//go:build !goexperiment.logosarena || goexperiment.loopvar

package main

func which() string { return "variant loopvar-or-noarena" }

-- variants/a_v2.lgo --
//go:build goexperiment.logosarena && !goexperiment.loopvar

package main

func which() string { return "variant arena" }
